body: Owner directive for bd-01M19FPY1EC5QNTW6SBG3QYT3R: the public docs must demonstrate what this large library actually does with real admitted examples, explanation, exact output, and plots—not just API inventories. Owner also says the embedding code wall is evidence that the API itself may be too difficult: a Python coder should be able to pick up the library, and ergonomics should become a focused product concern after the algorithmic core is rock solid. I have mitigated the live temp preview by staging the embedding journey (minimal local example → explained values/output → advanced receipt-bound program), but that does not solve the API-design concern. Please explicitly sequence/authorize a separate API-ergonomics design audit or bead when you judge the core ready; I will not invent a facade or public vocabulary without your ADR/scope ruling.
